excerpt: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics measures inflation by tracking price changes for a basket of goods and services. The latest CPI report shows a 0.5% increase in May 2026, driven by higher gasoline and shelter costs. For more details, visit the BLS CPI page.

content.introduction: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics measures inflation by tracking price changes for a basket of goods and services. The latest CPI report shows a 0.5% increase in May 2026, driven by higher gasoline and shelter costs. For more details, visit the BLS CPI page.
